entry.title: The First Hubble Detection of a Secondary Eclipse from a Rocky Exoplanet: the 5.4-hour planet TOI-2431 b
entry.content:
Authors: S Zieba, B Edwards, SN Quinn, LJ Janssen, NB Cowan... - arXiv preprint arXiv ..., 2026

Abstract: We present an HST/WFC3 G141 phase-curve observation of the ultra-short-period rocky planet TOI-2431 b and detect its secondary eclipse in the near infrared. Combined with the TESS optical eclipse, these measurements constrain the planet's ...
